svg.title: red root sketch
svg.desc:
A red root has two Empty children. Each terminal Empty counts as black, so both paths have one black form. The red root adds no black form to either path.
Source (svg): <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="300" height="200" viewBox="0 0 300 200"><line x1="150" y1="65" x2="80" y2="118" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/><line x1="150" y1="65" x2="220" y2="118" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/><rect x="70" y="15" width="160" height="50" rx="3" fill="white" stroke="#555"/><text x="150" y="49" text-anchor="middle" font-size="25" fill="#222">Red root</text><rect x="18" y="118" width="124" height="68" rx="2" fill="white" stroke="#555"/><text x="80" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="25" fill="#222">Empty</text><text x="80" y="175" text-anchor="middle" font-size="25" fill="#222">Black</text><rect x="158" y="118" width="124" height="68" rx="2" fill="white" stroke="#555"/><text x="220" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="25" fill="#222">Empty</text><text x="220" y="175" text-anchor="middle" font-size="25" fill="#222">Black</text></svg>
